in_hebrew.name: תְאוֹגֶן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew 'תָאוֹג', 'god', and 'נֶגֶן', 'born'. So, 'Theagenes' in Hebrew would mean 'God's born one'.

in_greek.name: Θεαγένης
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek 'Θεός', 'God', and 'γενής', 'born'. So, 'Theagenes' in Greek would mean 'God's born one'.

in_latin.name: Theagenes
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin 'Deus', 'God', and 'natus', 'born'. So, 'Theagenes' in Latin would mean 'God's born one'.
